hama1.name: hama1
hama1.status: provisional: actor held-out finger pads 1.7 px (hama1) / 1.0 px (hama2), two-view 0.4 px, with tcp.hand_offset_m and latency applied; scored with the base.xml hand (as measure_b0 does today) the same marks read about 12 px, so B0.kp_* needs the base.xml stack fix first. Exploratory: episode 0 only
hama1.method: robot-keypoint bundle adjustment (calibrate_static_cameras, twin/camcal.py): render-and-compare of black joint caps (links 3-6) + finger pads on 557 frames, 8 plate-corner marks; hama1+hama2 jointly with shared f/cx/cy, per-camera latency, tool offset and board plate height; Cauchy loss; 3 iterations from the previous calib. Fit: runs/claude/run-standin-1/world/static_fit.json

hand.name: hand
hand.status: provisional: board leave-one-hole-out 4.9 px, pad inner corners on 77 held-out open frames 4.5 px, both with tcp.hand_offset_m applied (camera pose is in the corrected hand frame); with the base.xml hand the board points are about 23 mm closer than in reality, so measure_b0 needs the stack fix first. Exploratory
hand.method: wrist camera in the tool-corrected hand frame (calibrate_hand_camera): 15 hole marks on 15 frames (5 holes) + finger-pad top corners on the open/closed hand medians, f prior 615+-20 px, principal point at the centre. Fit: runs/claude/run-standin-1/world/hand_fit.json

frame: robot base frame = FR3 link0 = MuJoCo world = mocap world (docs/research/reassemble-data-notes.md)
camera_convention: pos/quat: MuJoCo camera frame (x right, y up, looks along -z) in its parent frame; fx fy cx cy in pixels at width x height, OpenCV pixel centres; T_parent_cam_opencv = OpenCV camera axes (x right, y down, z forward) in the parent frame

board.source: x, y, yaw from robot contacts (board_contact, board_from_contacts); z = plate top from the two calibrated static cameras (plate corners triangulated with the robot-calibrated cameras: board_contact z 0.0079 + 30.3 mm, about +-4 mm)

plate_in_board_frame.source: twin/assets/board_nist_plate.json (NIST laser plate at the contact layout)

tcp.source: FK of logged joints vs logged O_T_EE (0.6 mm max over episode 0)
tcp.hand_offset_note: Physical hand (and fingers, and the wrist camera mount) sits this far along the hand z axis from where base.xml puts it: both static cameras see the finger pads 22.9 mm closer to the flange than base.xml (F/T stack 47.7 mm, not 70.6; the REASSEMBLE URDF stack is 44.5 mm). The logged O_T_EE (0.174 m from the flange) therefore lies about 23 mm beyond the pad centres. base.xml is unchanged (replay builds on it); renders apply it with view.set_hand_offset(calib_hand_offset(rec)). Proposed fix: FT_STACK = 0.0706 + hand_offset_m in build_base.py, with the tcp site moved by -hand_offset_m so it stays on O_T_EE.

notes: Episode 0 only (exploratory). Recalibrated 2026-10-24 from robot keypoints (playbook/skills/world-frame, twin/camcal.py). Three twin corrections came out of the fit: (1) tcp.hand_offset_m: the physical hand is 22.9 mm closer to the flange than base.xml; (2) board z: plate top 30.3 mm above the mocap/contact z; (3) the rendered plate is the 384 mm NIST plate (twin/assets/board_nist_plate.json) on a base slab, not the 400 x 400 x 25 mm placeholder. cameras.*.latency_frames: the video lags the joint log by that many frames (FK at frame + latency matches the image). Previous values under "previous".

board_contact.layout: hole positions are in the file (board_xy per hole), from a layout refit on all train recordings except this one; full train layout: runs/claude/run-standin-1/board/layout_contact.json
board_contact.source: robot contact events of this recording: 15 insert seats / remove grasps from 15 parts, robust point-to-line fit of the rigid hole layout; closing-axis residual median 0.85 mm (twin/board_fit.py, tool board_from_contacts)
board_contact.frame: board = mocap NIST_Board1 convention (plate corner origin, z up); x, y, yaw from contacts; pos z copied from the mocap "board" entry because contacts do not pin z (grasp height varies 2-7 mm MAD per part; z_from_contacts kept for reference); roll = pitch = 0
board_contact.note: Leave-one-part-out on 24 gate recordings: closing-axis hole error 1.23 mm (contact) vs 4.08 mm (mocap). Mocap entry "board" kept unchanged.

previous.note: Values before the robot-keypoint recalibration of 2026-10-24 21:13. The static cameras came from silhouette/edge refinement (refine_camera) and the edge-overlay check; an independent watcher measured them at 5.35 px (hama1) and 16 px (hama2) on held-out finger pads, 7.1 px two-view, wrist camera 33 px. Kept for comparison only.
